results.title: Angola gets win over Columbia City in opener
results.description: ANGOLA – New Angola High School head girls volleyball coach Eva Foulk admitted to having some pre-match jitters as her Hornets prepared to open the 2026 season Saturday morning against Columbia City.

results.title: Detroit Tigers Finally Cut Ties With Former High Draft Pick
results.description: The Detroit Tigers have designated outfielder Trei Cruz for assignment, clearing a spot on the 40-man and active rosters for outfielder Brett Callahan, whose contract was selected from Triple-A Toledo.
